import urllib.request,json
base="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/"
for section,version_field,expected in [("", "revision",13),("native/","version_code",18)]:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+section+"latest.json",headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache"}),timeout=8) as r:
  assert r.status==200
  m=json.loads(json.load(r)["payload"])
  assert m[version_field]==expected, "Wrong published version"
  print(json.dumps({"resource":section+"latest.json","status":r.status,"version":expected,"sha256":m["sha256"]}))
  request=urllib.request.Request(base+section+m["file"],method="HEAD")
  with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=8) as file:
   assert file.status==200 and int(file.headers.get("Content-Length","0"))==m["size"], "Payload missing/mismatch"
   print(json.dumps({"resource":section+"binary","status":file.status,"bytes":m["size"]}))
